question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched authority as CCP General Secretary, state president, and Central Military Commission chairman drives the 96% trader consensus against removal before 2027. Term-limit abolition in 2018 and loyalist appointments at the 20th Party Congress, reinforced by ongoing military leadership adjustments through 2026, have eliminated visible factional challenges or succession signals. Public appearances, policy directives on economic planning for 2026-2030, and diplomatic engagements show continuity rather than elite realignment. Historical patterns tie major leadership changes to scheduled congresses rather than abrupt shifts. Unforeseen developments such as a serious health event, sharp economic downturn prompting internal consensus, or external crisis eroding cohesion could still alter this trajectory before year-end 2026.
